svg.text: Phase 2 · step 4e · Vehicles: the chosen layout (option A, a Sort menu, and groups in the sidebar)

Chosen 2026-11-01 from docs/ui-sketches/p2m4-garage-options.svg. Each group is a sidebar item; All vehicles shows them all. Sort: Newest activity, Name (A–Z), or Custom (with Arrange). Pinning later (idea 15).
All vehicles: every group as a section (the sidebar lists the groups; the Sort menu open)
Tap a card to open it. All vehicles shows only when you can see more than one group; groups in name order.
A group's own page (Garage selected): Sort: Custom → Arrange
A group's page: only its vehicles; + Add vehicle starts in it.
Custom shows Arrange: ▲▼ on each card (48 px) until Done.
The sort and the custom order are yours alone (#040).
One-group household: the sidebar shows just ⌂ Garage
(no All vehicles), so nothing changes for them.
sidebar: each group shows its icon, its name as a tooltip.
Later (idea 15): pin vehicles to the top of their group.
Phone: the first tab is Vehicles; the menu
at the top picks All vehicles or a group
+ Add vehicle: step 1 (kind) and step 2 (details), in a dialog
Starts with an Odometer (km, your preference) and the truck's
custom fields; change them later on its Setup tab.
